Milki Delivery Demo

Wishlist the full game on Steam!

Explore Nodoka Fields, the first region of a larger journey, in this approximately 45 minute demo for Milki Delivery! As Neha, you'll deliver milk to locals like Yoyo and Grandma Yuma as you complete quests, gather resources, upgrade your bike and farm, care for your pet cow, and discover more surprises along the way!

Deliver Milk 🐮

You and Milki are starting a dairy delivery service! Earn money, collect resources, upgrade your barn, and slowly grow your business.

Explore the countryside 🌻

Lush meadows, green forests, a glittering ocean: this land has so much beauty to discover! To see it all and meet everyone, you'll need to upgrade your bike and choose your path wisely.

Reconnect the Community 💌

Once known for its booming milk industry, this region has slowly been deserted after a mysterious event that affected all of the cows. Delivery after delivery, the residents will tell you more about their past as you build a future together!

Features

✅ What Milki Delivery offers:

  • A short adventure: 2-3h of beautiful landscapes, light management, gentle decisions, and concise dialogue.
  • Simple game mechanics: Choose your path, sell milk, gather ingredients, and complete little quests.
  • A cozy mood: Summer vibes, hand-drawn side-scrolling landscapes, cute characters, and lovely music!
  • Everything is kept simple with no possibility of failure: play at your own pace!

❌ What Milki Delivery does NOT offer:

  • No big odyssey with hours-long quests or a branching narrative.
  • No multiplayer of any kind.

Dev team

Hey, this is Blibloop and Doot talking! After making Minami Lane together, we wanted to explore something entirely different with a game less centered on management and more on discovery of both a world and its people.

For this game, we’re collaborating once again with Zakku, our composer, whose music and sounds continue to shape the heart of our games.

This is new to us and we still consider ourselves beginners, so please be kind with your expectations, and know that we will do our best! We really hope you'll enjoy our little game, Milki Delivery 💖
